Actual remaining time is revealed for evaluation only. It is never an input to the prediction model.

Potential application: parent pickup notifications or passenger arrival estimates. Boarding confirmation and safety alerts would require separate systems.

How well do the models perform?

ModelMean errorTrip-balanced errorWithin 2 minutes

Whole journeys held out

A fixed trip-level split keeps every observation from a test journey out of training. Multiple GPS points are not counted as independent journeys.

Only available information

Inputs use current position, known destination, elapsed time, recent speed, hour and weekday. Full-trip speed, duration and ratings are excluded.

A research prototype

Small Brazilian dataset. Recorded endpoints may not be actual bus terminals. Accuracy on Ghanaian routes has not been measured.

Run TabPFN-3.5

The project includes an explicit TabPFN-3.5 Plus pipeline. Authenticate with Prior Labs locally, then run python benchmark.py --tabpfn. Serve the regenerated dist/ folder to explore its real predictions here.

Until that run succeeds, TabPFN has no score and is not offered in the model selector. The demo never substitutes another model under the TabPFN name.

Data: UCI GPS Trajectories · Cruz, Macedo, Barreto & Guimares · DOI 10.24432/C54S5Z. Public research data from Brazil.
